name: The Held Door
pitch: A terrified nurse puts a second ward around the enemy instead of themself, and inside it the fever never breaks, for as long as they can bear to hold the door.

new.name: Sealed Room
new.effect: Per-pulse ward, pass 0.55, upkeep_share 0.03, around the enemy. Hits leaving them and hits going in both meet it, and only its holder pays. Carries Nothing Leaves.
new.second_home: a healer who wards an ally, a jailer sect

new.name: Vinegar Cloth
new.effect: Per-hit ward, pass 0.34 body and 0.24 qi, hit_cost_share 0.04.
new.second_home: any build that counts its pool

new.name: Soiled Gown
new.effect: Drain ward, pass 0.55 body and 0.45 qi, drain 1.2 and 1.5, cheap and thin, made to go over another.

new.name: Nothing Leaves
new.effect: While the ward stands, your statuses on the enemy lose no duration and the enemy does not regenerate. If it cannot be paid it falls for the fight and those statuses end.
new.second_home: any curse build, any holding formation

new.name: Sweat
new.effect: Qi, c_art 0.6, cost 0.05, 1 s, own linh lực 60 % or above. Body tick, c_tick 0.5, 2 pulses, poison tag.

new.name: Flux
new.effect: As Sweat. Body tick, no poison tag.

new.name: Ague
new.effect: As Sweat. Qi tick. Foundation Establishment.

new.name: Night-Sitter's Method
new.effect: Main, Hoàng giai, Wood, no bonuses. Carries the three sicknesses.

new.name: A ward on the other person
new.effect: A ward may stand around the enemy, paid only by its holder. Rule 22.
